title: fix: load maintained project skills in Codex
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Link 20 maintained project skills from `.claude/skills/` into `.agents/skills/` so Codex can discover them without duplicated instructions.
- Add one small adapter for the existing review command.
- Document the shared-skill layout in `AGENTS.md`. No runtime code or secrets change.

gist.headline: One shelf, two agents
gist.blurb: Codex gets a path to the project’s maintained skills. The instructions stay in one place, which is a small mercy for everyone maintaining them.
gist.summary: Linked 20 maintained project skills from `.claude/skills/` into `.agents/skills/`, added an adapter for the existing review command, and documented the shared layout in `AGENTS.md` so Codex can discover the skills without duplicated instructions.
gist.impact: Contributors using Codex get access to the same maintained project guidance, including the review command, with no runtime code changes.
gist.visual_concept: Show a cozy shared library of skill books, with two retro terminals reading from the same shelf rather than separate copies. Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, connects the shelf to the Codex terminal; a small review-command card sits beside it. Add potted code-plants.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art library, two retro terminals share one shelf of skill books while Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, gently connects the Codex terminal to it beside potted code-plants and a small review-command card. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized, and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes; a prominent soft lime green (#ecf874) glow warms the cream-and-lavender room, with dark purple (#110518) outlines.
